title: ze_mount_seela
description:
ZE_MOUNT_SEELA, by DLM 

You find yourself in a Limbo between Heaven and Hell. You were no saint in your past life, but the deities have offered you the chance to redeem yourself and have therefore decided to put you to the test.

However, only few have ever seen the top... Will you be up to the trials and complete Mount Seela? 

Your long path to redemption begins here.

 Map Features 

The map was designed to be purely and only zombie defense. No bosses, no items, but 8 unique challenges/puzzles to complete throughout a single stage, which is about 25-30 minutes long.

There are two possible endings.

////////////////////

Map design inspiration from a "Call of Duty: Black Ops 3" custom zombie map of the same name, by Verk0.
Though, extensively redesigned to suit the Zombie Escape game mode.
